gazette_location.description_raw_en: No. 1043.— It is hereby notified that the following street(s)/road(s) will be known in future as described hereunder:— Description: Thoroughfare as shown coloured pink on Drawing No. KH3166, commencing at its junction with Sze Shan Street near the junction of Cho Yuen Street and Sze Shan Street, running in a south-westerly direction for about 45 m, turning north-westerly for about 120 m, then turning north-easterly for about 45 m and terminating at its junction with Sze Shan Street. Proposed Name: SHUNG YIU STREET. Chinese Version: 崇耀街.
gazette_location.description_raw_zh: 此道路位置在 KH3166 號圖則上以粉紅色標明，起點在草園街與四山街交界處附近，與四山街連接，向西南伸展約四十五米，轉向西北伸展約一百二十米，然後再轉向東北伸展約四十五米，在與四山街連接處終結。
